title: Unity windows not snapping to declared zones when in editor.

comment.body: Thanks for checking the transparency setting. Your latest Unity scenario is covered by #24174: turning off FancyZones → Make dragged window transparent is the reported workaround for the freezing/black-rendering case. That does not establish that the older Unity2021/2022 detached-window eligibility issue is fixed. If a window still cannot enter a zone with transparency disabled, keep that as a separate case with the exact Unity/PowerToys versions and window type; there is no need to repeat the dialog/popup option check already answered above.

judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge the transparency-off workaround for the latest scenario and keep any remaining no-snap legacy case separate.
evidence: Original Unity2021 detached views failed to zone despite the requested dialog/popup options; later Unity2022 reports persisted.
The latest participant reports newer native dialog behavior and freezing/black rendering during FancyZones snapping, then explicitly says disabling transparency on drag resolves that scenario.

Open24174 describes the exact Unity plus Make Dragged Window Transparent rendering failure. The linked32485 request concerns native Unity editor windows and is closed; that alone does not prove older custom windows supported.
judgment.rationale: Route the newly isolated rendering symptom to24174 and preserve the distinction from old ineligible custom Unity windows. Do not repeat the already answered dialog-option ask or declare all Unity versions fixed.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open24174 already tracks the demonstrated transparency interaction; this is existing investigation/workaround coverage, not an identified shipped repair for every Unity window.

inferences: Transparency-related rendering loss in newer Unity and failure to recognize older custom detached windows are different mechanisms.
